Rajendra Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on
23 March, 2023
Author: Vivek Kumar Birla

Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 4472 of 2023
Petitioner :- Rajendra Singh And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Petitioner :- Akshay Kumar Shukla,Ravindra Pal Singh Kashyap

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri RP.S. Kashyap, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Sushil Jaiswal, learned State Law Officer, for the State respondents.

The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 13.02.2021, registered as Case Crime No. 0124 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 IPC, Police Station Khurja Nagar,
District Bulandhshar.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioners in the aforesaid case.
Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that the allegation levelled against the petitioners are absolutely false.

He further submits that the petitioners are marginal witnesses and Rajendra Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42902876/
1 have no concerned with the offence.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA pointed out that chargesheet has already been submitted in respect of co-accused- Ajeet Singh on 01.12.2021 and the first information report cannot be quashed in part, however, he submits that co-accused Ajeet Singh has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 27.11.2021 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.50342 of 2021.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.50342 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submits that investigation is pending in respect of petitioners herein.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
